verdict.rationale: Sill's host runs on macOS and its viewer on iPhone/iPad, and the iOS client is a public TestFlight beta, so host and viewer do run on different operating systems. Coverage is narrow, though: the evidence shows only a Mac host and only iOS/iPadOS clients. missing for 10: Windows/Linux hosts, any desktop viewer client, Android or other non-Apple mobile clients, a non-beta App Store release of the mobile client.

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems

citations.quote: Sill shows a window from your Mac, or its whole desktop, on your iPhone or iPad
Sill for iPhone and iPad: join the [public beta on TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/6v7nqyn3).
Direct Wireless Connection lets an iPhone or iPad near your Mac connect without a shared Wi-Fi network
